text: This is C-Cube: a palm-sized AI assistant for your desk. Always in a good mood.
I designed it together with an AI, in just a few days.
The AI wrote a program that builds the 3D model in Fusion.
Bugs? We found them together, and fixed them.
Then the AI reviewed the model by itself, and even picked the colors.
Every step went into the log.
Round display. Camera. Two mics. Stereo speakers. RGB lights. Battery. And rubber corners. Why? You'll see.
Do not disturb? It just buzzes gently.
It pairs with your phone, and works as a speakerphone.
New: cat mode. Pet the roof, and it purrs.
